plan: My private value is $10. In a first-price sealed bid auction with rational opponents, I want to bid strategically. Since my value is relatively low, I'll bid slightly below my value to maximize potential profit. Rational opponents will also bid below their true value. I'll aim to bid around $8-9, which gives me a small potential profit margin if I win, while minimizing risk of overbidding. The goal is to win only if the price is sufficiently below my true value.
